title: 4 hour Party Pontoon Cruise Lake Tahoe! (10ppl)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Every charter is fully customizable to your group's preferences! Simply arrive, hop aboard, and your adventure begins.

Once underway, your captain can take you anywhere you'd like to explore on beautiful Lake Tahoe. Whether you're interested in sightseeing, swimming, relaxing at secluded beaches, or discovering hidden gems around the lake, your captain will help create the perfect day on the water.

Our captains are happy to recommend popular destinations, share local knowledge, take photos of your group, and even let you experience a turn in the captain's seat when conditions allow.

Feel free to bring your own food, drinks, and alcohol to enjoy during your trip (we simply ask that you leave the red wine at home).

Your boat, your itinerary, your Tahoe adventure.
